cityTours.label: City Tours
cityTours.title: Discover Panama City
cityTours.description: Daytime and nighttime tours through the capital's most iconic corners.

ecoTours.label: Ecotourism & Nature
ecoTours.title: Experience Panama's wild side
ecoTours.description: Rainforest, rivers, island paradises and the Panama Canal in a single experience.

shopping.label: Shopping
shopping.title: Colón Free Zone
shopping.description: The second-largest free trade zone in the world, in the Western Hemisphere.

city_tour.name: Panama City Tour
city_tour.description: Spend half a day with us exploring the history and the modern life of a city shaped by so many cultures, old and new.
includes: Modern city: Cinta Costera, Balboa Theater, Canal Administration Building
Casco Antiguo, the old quarter: Metropolitan Cathedral, Golden Altar Church, Puente de los Enamorados
Amador Duty Free (Causeway) and Albrook Mall

city_tour_night.name: Panama City Night Tour
city_tour_night.description: Discover a magical spot by the sea where you can take in the Panama City skyline on a warm, history-filled night.

nightlife.name: Night Tour — Nightlife
nightlife.description: One of the most popular destinations for locals and visitors alike in Panama City, thanks to its variety of food, drinks of every style and nightclubs.

gamboa.name: Monkey Island — Gamboa
gamboa.description: Head out onto the waters of Gatún Lake by boat and discover Panama's astonishing biodiversity. Spot monkeys, sloths, caimans and hundreds of tropical birds in their natural habitat while navigating the highest point of the Panama Canal.
includes: Monkey, sloth and tropical bird watching

san_blas.name: San Blas
san_blas.description: Time stands still in the heartland of Guna culture, a place of white sand and crystal-clear water. Visit 3 islands: Isla Perro Chico, Isla Wailidub and the Natural Pools.

embera.name: Emberá — Indigenous Community
embera.description: Take in the biodiversity as you travel up the Chagres River, and share in the roots and traditions of the Emberá indigenous community.

transito.name: Partial Transit — Panama Canal
transito.description: Experience the Panama Canal aboard a ferry along its historic waterway. Take in this engineering marvel and see how it works.

zona_libre.name: Colón Free Zone
zona_libre.description: Considered the second-largest free trade zone in the world and the first in the Western Hemisphere. Famous for unlimited, tax-free shopping: electronics, liquor, furniture, clothing, shoes, jewelry, watches and perfumes from the most renowned brands.
includes: Round-trip transfer to the Colón Free Zone
